    AI Overview
    In a 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 thriller on
    March 26, the #2 seed Purdue Boilermakers defeated the #11 seed Texas Longhorns 79-77 at the SAP Center in San Jose, Calif.. Trey Kaufman-Renn hit a last-second tip-in following a missed runner by Braden Smith to break a 77-77 tie with 0.7 seconds remaining, sending Purdue to the Elite Eight. 
    Key 2026 Sweet 16 Timeline (March 26, 2026): 
    • First Half: Purdue took a 39-35 lead into halftime , fueled by Fletcher Loyer's hot start and perfect shooting from Trey Kaufman-Renn.
    • Early Second Half: Texas opened the half with a 14-6 run , leading 49-45 at 15:37, aided by a 3-pointer from Camden Heide.
    • Mid-Second Half: Tramon Mark kept Texas competitive despite a rolled ankle , with the teams trading leads and playing tightly through the 10-minute mark.
    • Final Minute: Texas' Dailyn Swain scored a driving layup and free throw to tie the game at 77-77 with 11.9 seconds left.
    • Final Second: Trey Kaufman-Renn's tip-in with 0.7 seconds remaining sealed the 79-77 win for the Boilermakers. 
    Game Summary: 
    • Score: Purdue 79, Texas 77.
    • Site: SAP Center, San Jose, CA (West Regional Semifinal).
    • Top Performers: Tramon Mark (Texas) carried the offense, while Kaufman-Renn and Loyer led Purdue.
    • Outcome: Purdue advanced to the Elite Eight; Texas ended their season at 21-15.
